title: Drop the tolerated purpose and delivery_tokens fields from Engram host frames
outcome: Found 2026-09-26 during the tm-zykn consult with Engram::Fable. TermAl always sends purpose on turn_evaluate (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:574, plain String, no skip) and delivery_tokens on turn_begin (:581, Vec<String>, sent as [] when empty; sourced from the grant at ~4398/6341). Engram HostControlRequest (host.rs 33-80, deny_unknown_fields) tolerates both only 'while hosts still send it' (host.rs 52-65): purpose must be ordinary and any non-empty delivery_tokens refuses the begin. Follow-up, not part of tm-zykn: stop sending both fields (and drop the delivery_tokens plumbing from the grant model and tests in src/tests/engram_control_transport.rs), then tell Engram so it can remove the tolerance. Coordinate the order: TermAl stops sending first; Engram removes tolerance after. No behaviour change otherwise; frames must stay byte-identical apart from the two removed fields.
acceptance:
- turn_evaluate frames carry no purpose field and turn_begin frames carry no delivery_tokens field (fixture asserting the serialized JSON).
- Engram at the pinned build accepts the frames (focused live check or the transport fixture mirroring host.rs 33-80).
- No other frame field changes (byte-identical fixture apart from the two removals); cargo check clean, cargo test --bin termal green.
- Engram::Fable notified with the TermAl commit hash so the tolerance can be removed on the Engram side.
